choices: Disjunction P ∨ Q corresponds to the product type P × Q
Implication P → Q corresponds to the product type P × Q
Negation ¬P corresponds to the sum type P + ⊥
Disjunction P ∨ Q corresponds to the sum type P + Q
explanation: Disjunction ∨ corresponds to the sum (coproduct) type +, and a proof injects a proof of one disjunct. Option A is the classic mistake (∨ is +, not ×; × is ∧). Implication is the function type, not × (B); negation ¬P is the function type P → ⊥, not a sum (C).
